title: Applicant Landlords: Anne O’Dwyer and Declan Taite – Respondent Tenants: Kevin McGinley, James Hughes
text:
Residential Tenancies Board

Determination Order

Ref: DR0917-37290

In the matter of Anne O'Dwyer & Declan Taite (Receivers over certain assets of Leo
Meenagh) [Applicant Landlords] and Kevin McGinley, James Hughes [Respondent Tenants]
the Residential Tenancies Board, in accordance with section 121 of the Residential
Tenancies Act 2004, determines that:

1.

The Notice of Termination served on 10 August 2017 by the Applicant Receiver on
the Respondent Tenants in respect of the tenancy of the dwelling at 37 The Swift,
Tsaggard Green, Saggart, County Dublin, D24 RP70, is valid.

The Respondent Tenants and all persons residing in the above dwelling shall vacate
and give up possession of the above dwelling within 14 days of the date of issue of
this Order.

The Respondent Tenants shall pay the total sum of €5,901.05 to the Applicant
Receiver, within 14 days of the date of issue of the Order, being rent arrears in
respect of the tenancy of the above dwelling.

The Respondent Tenants shall also pay any further rent outstanding from 22
November 2017, being the date of the Adjudication hearing, at the rate of €850.00
per month or proportional part thereof at the rate of €27.95 per day, unless lawfully
varied, and any other charges as set out in the terms of the tenancy agreement for
each month or part thereof, until such time as the Respondent Tenants vacate the
above dwelling.

The Landlord shall refund the entire of the security deposit of €850.00 to the
Respondent Tenants, upon the Respondent Tenants vacating and giving up vacant
possession of the above dwelling, less any amounts properly withheld in accordance
with the provisions of the Act.

This Order was made by the Residential Tenancies Board on 05 January 2018.

Justin O’Brien Claire Diggin
Board Member Higher Executive Officer
